|title=A Pile of Sand
|icon=Aiel
|setting=[[Cairhien (city)]], [[Salidar]]

{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

Egwene is still recovering from the attack on her by [[Lanfear]], when [[Moiraine]] and Lanfear fought and both died. When she looks in the mirror she is blushing as she remembers the dream she shared with [[Gawyn]] and what happened there. She decides to sleep a bit longer to recover from being in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' all night. She has some [[Egwene's dreams|dreams]]:

* Egwene cupping Gawyn's face in her hands.{{ref|Egwene [[bonding]] Gawyn as her warder. Fulfilled in ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'', [[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 38|Chapter 38]].}}
* Twice she dreamed of turning him around against his will. The first time he pushed her hands away. The second time she was stronger and forced him around.
* In another Gawyn was closing a door and she knew that if he closed it all the way she would die.{{ref|This is Gawyn abandoning her when she uses herself as bait to capture [[Mesaana]], then returning in time to save her from [[Seanchan]] [[Bloodknife|Bloodknives]]. Fulfilled in ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'', [[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 15|Chapter 15]], [[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 23|Chapter 23]], and [[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 37|Chapter 37]]}}
* [[Perrin]] with [[Hopper|a wolf]] at his feet, and [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|a falcon]] and [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron|a hawk]] on his shoulders glaring at each other, while he tries to throw away his axe.
* Perrin turning away from a [[Tinker]] and running from him.{{ref|This is [[Aram]] attempting to kill Perrin. Fulfilled in ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'', [[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 30|Chapter 30]].}}
* [[Mat]] speaking the [[Old Tongue]] while two ravens land on his shoulder, sinking in their claws.{{ref|This is Mat becoming the Prince of the Ravens. Fulfilled in ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'', [[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 27|Chapter 37]].}}
* A woman beckons Mat toward great danger but her face is shrouded.{{ref|This might be [[Moiraine's letter to Thom]] that convinces Mat to come save her from the [[Finn]].}}
* [[Elayne]] forcing [[Rand]] to his knees.
* Elayne, [[Min]], and [[Aviendha]] in a circle around Rand, then each laying a hand on him.{{ref|This is Elayne, Min, and Aviendha bonding Rand. Fulfilled in ''[[Winter's Heart]]'', [[Winter's Heart/Chapter 12|Chapter 12]].}}
* Rand walking toward [[Shayol Ghul|a burning mountain]] while something crunched beneath his boots―the [[Seals]] on the Dark One's prison.{{ref|This is when [[Logain]] destroys the remaining Seals as Rand reforges the Dark One's prison. Fulfilled in ''[[A Memory of Light]]'', [[A Memory of Light/Chapter 47|Chapter 47]], [[A Memory of Light/Chapter 48|Chapter 48]], and [[A Memory of Light/Chapter 49|Chapter 49]].}}

[[Cowinde]] wakes her and she decides to skip breakfast until [[Amys]] wonders what is wrong with her to not be hungry. She then decides she needs to make the [[Wise One]]s believe her to be healed, so she eats. [[Melaine]] becomes irritated with Cowinde, who should have put off the white by now, and sends her to perform a useless task looking for a red grain of sand in a pile of sand near her tent. The Wise Ones discuss Egwene's health and when she will have permission to return to ''Tel'aran'rhiod''. The Salidar Aes Sedai are very insistent that Egwene come to the next meeting. After asking the Wise Ones some questions, Egwene mostly resolves to avoid Gawyn's dreams in the future.

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

A large crowd waits outside the Little Tower to hear the results of the negotiations between the Salidar Hall and the [[White Tower]] representative, [[Tarna Feir]]. Elayne is very tired, having stayed awake most of the night dealing with the aftermath of the [[bubble of evil]]. [[Nynaeve]] joins her, even more tired since she did not go to bed at all trying to comply with [[Theodrin]]'s orders to stay awake all night to see if that breaks her [[block]] on [[channeling]]. [[Siuan]] joins them, with everyone impatient for the announcement. In the end, nothing has changed. Salidar will not return to the White Tower while [[Elaida]] is the [[Amyrlin]].

Nynaeve goes to speak to [[Sheriam]], with Elayne following. They ask to speak privately with Sheriam, [[Morvrin]], and [[Carlinya]]. Nynaeve tells them of the ''ter'angreal''{{ref|The [[Bowl of the Winds]].}} they found in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' last night and that it may be able to affect the weather. Nynaeve and Elayne wish to go to [[Ebou Dar]] to find it but the Aes Sedai won't let [[Accepted]] make the trip. They decide to send a letter to [[Merilille]], an Aes Sedai in [[Ebou Dar]], instead. To try to bring the Salidar Aes Sedai together with Rand, Elayne tells them the bowl will need a man channeling to work.{{ref|Elayne is lying, but she's actually right. The Bowl of the Winds ''does'' require the use of both ''[[saidin]]'' and ''[[saidar]]''.}} Nynaeve then berates the [[Aes Sedai]] for not doing anything proactive and gets a punishment for her outburst.

{{pov|[[Sheriam Bayanar]]}}

Sheriam, Carlinya, and Morvrin are watching Elayne and Nynaeve at their chores through the fence. They have plans for the criticisms that were made, but can't make them public yet. They still don't know how they should handle Rand, though.
